text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, dates, passengers, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) with matching parameters, but it adds extras (direct-only, time filters, flexible ticket) that the true occurrence didn't use, and it leaves passengers and filters a little loose, so a browser automation could be built from it with only minor guesswork."}

data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, dates, passengers, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) with matching parameters, but it adds extras (direct-only, time filters, flexible ticket) that the true occurrence didn't use, and it leaves passengers and filters a little loose, so a browser automation could be built from it with only minor guesswork.
